hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA).
